KEY FINDINGS: (1) CALENDAR Rakuten prepaid = cheapest no-KYC JP keep-alive at ¥5,400/yr renewal (official extension flow verified incl. 15th-of-expiry-month deadline, MSN-based remote extension, card-only); community 8/8 platform SMS test 2026-08; (2) IF Mobile = full voice+SMS but Japan Apr-2026 KYC tightening broke new-customer activation per fluctlight tracker — HOLD; (3) KR confirmed dead market for non-residents: ARC gate (kimchimobile 2026-06) + visa-tied invalidation (naixi 2025-12) — skt-prepaid route upgraded to avoidRoute negative-knowledge; (4) HanaCell considered and rejected (Japan-only SMS, must physically use in Japan, ~$8/mo); (5) LINEMO/ahamo/Rakuten postpaid all require JP residence docs — not viable for overseas users, captured via povo holdReason already.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Korea ties every mobile line to verified identity; for foreigners that proof is the physical ARC (Alien Registration Card), issued only after >90-day residence registration. Tourist/short-stay visitors can only get data eSIMs or airport tourist prepaid SIMs whose validity follows the stay (≤90 days). Postpaid conversion requires ARC + Korean bank account (kimchimobile 2026-06).

keep.action: BLOCKED for non-residents: no ARC = no long-term Korean number. Tourist prepaid dies with the stay; numbers registered to expiring visas are invalidated (community 2025-12). KYB-resold "registered" numbers exist but are gray-market, expensive, and die when the underlying visa lapses.

routes.chinaActivation: KR foreigner SIMs: tourist (passport, short validity) vs ARC-based (long-term).
routes.holdReason: Regulatory ARC gate = not viable for overseas retention. Documented as negative-knowledge to save users wasted effort. KR is a dead market for China-based keep-alive as of 2026-09.
routes.tariffSummary: Tourist 1-90 day products; long-term needs ARC.
guideSteps: Directory card — Korea not retention-friendly for non-residents.

routes.acquisitionSummary: No-KYC 1-year prepaid SIM/eSIM on Rakuten Mobile network (+au partner + intl roaming) sold by calendar-world (株式会社CALENDAR) via jpsimshop / Rakuten marketplace / Amazon JP. 3GB/mo plan ¥5,980 new (community 2026-06 & 2026-08 agree); 6-month option from ¥3,300 (official shop page). First month free = up to 13 months on 1-year plan. eSIM delivered digitally (no Japan address needed); physical SIM ships Japan-only (forwarding required). SMS receive-only (can receive, cannot send); NO voice calls. Real JP 070/080/090 number.

keep.action: Annual extension (通信期限延長) ¥5,400/12mo keeps the SAME number and same SIM/eSIM — remote procedure, no new SIM shipped. Official shop rule: order+payment must complete by 15th 14:00 JST of the expiry month (next business day if holiday); extension requires the SIM's MSN/phone number; buyer name must match original purchaser; credit card only (no Amazon Pay/bank transfer). Shop sends SMS expiry notice ~2 months before deadline. 1/2/3-year upfront variants also listed on Rakuten.

routes.chinaActivation: Yes — designed for it. Community-verified working from mainland China and Taiwan for SMS receiving: 2026-08 linux.do 9-country test scored 8/8 platforms (WhatsApp/Telegram/Google/Apple ID/PayPal/Instagram/TikTok/Amazon); V2EX OP used it in China for eplus/pia ticket registration (2023 thread, re-confirmed 2025-09). Activate by inserting eSIM/SIM with roaming on.
routes.kyc: None for direct purchase — it is a data+SMS-receive product, not a voice service, so it sits outside Japan's voice-KYC regime (tightened 2026-04 per fluctlight tracker).
routes.payment: Credit card (extension flow is card-only). Community reports some Visa/Mastercard BINs fail on purchase — retry with another card.
routes.wifiCalling: not applicable — no voice service on this product
routes.roamingSms: Official listing: overseas SMS receiving supported (海外でのSMS受信も可能). Abuse clause: malicious SMS use can get ALL functions permanently stopped by the carrier. Roaming data 1GB/mo on 3GB plan, 128kbps after cap; community measured ~400ms latency from China (Rakuten routes roaming via Orange/France).
routes.refund: not reconciled — shop page says unsupported-device use is non-refundable
routes.tariffSummary: ¥5,980 first year (13 mo w/ free month), ¥5,400/yr extension same number. No KYC, eSIM direct. SMS-receive only, no calls. 1GB/mo overseas roaming data.
guideSteps: Buy the 1-year 3GB eSIM plan from jpsimshop / Rakuten marketplace / Amazon JP (~¥5,980). Choose eSIM to skip Japan-only shipping.
Install eSIM, enable roaming; SMS receiving works abroad immediately. Do not abuse SMS (carrier can kill all functions).
Calendar the expiry: shop SMS-notices ~2 months before; extension order+payment must complete by the 15th 14:00 JST of expiry month (¥5,400, same number, remote).

routes.acquisitionSummary: JP MVNO (Chinese-run, popular with ticket-lottery users). Full service: voice calls + SMS send/receive, unlike CALENDAR. ¥5,500 opening fee + monthly from ~¥1,408 (1GB, Japan-only data) or ¥14,120/yr prepaid bundle (community 2026-06). eSIM via customer service (¥1,100 per device change); physical SIM EMS overseas ¥2,200. KYC: passport info page + selfie holding passport + SNS account entry. Chinese-language support via WeChat/小红书.

keep.action: Subscription — ¥1,408/mo (1GB tier) keeps the number; or ¥14,120/yr upfront bundle per community. Receiving SMS abroad is FREE; sending SMS from abroad ¥110-220/msg; roaming calls ¥275/30s (Asia).

routes.chinaActivation: Historically yes — activated from Taiwan (hollen9 2025) and mainland China per community; SIM roams onto local carriers (e.g. Chunghwa) with signal out of the box. BUT see holdReason.
routes.kyc: Passport + selfie-holding-passport upload; SNS (e.g. Facebook) account required in signup; name matching loose (kanji variants OK per user report).
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad free (official-ish fee sheet shared in community); sending from abroad ¥110-220/msg.
routes.holdReason: Japan tightened voice-service KYC in April 2026 (in-person passport presentation functionally required for voice+SMS services). Non-resident tracker fluctlight: IFMobile works for EXISTING subscribers but a new-customer activation was NOT completed in April 2026. Treat new signups as unproven until community confirms post-2026-04 activations.
routes.tariffSummary: ¥5,500 opening + ~¥1,408/mo (or ¥14,120/yr bundle). Full voice+SMS, free SMS receive abroad. Passport KYC. New activations uncertain since 2026-04 KYC tightening.
guideSteps: Hold — do not recommend for new users until post-2026-04 activation success is community-confirmed.
